description: Search US state legislative bills by jurisdiction, keyword, session, or subject. Returns bill summaries with identifier, title, latest action, passage date, and link to the OpenStates detail page. Covers all 50 US states and territories. Filter by session (e.g. "20252026"), classification (bill/resolution), or subject tag. Use bills_detail to fetch full text, sponsors, and voting records.

classification.description: Filter by bill type classification (e.g. "bill", "resolution", "joint resolution", "concurrent resolution").

jurisdiction.description: State or jurisdiction abbreviation to search bills in (e.g. "ca", "tx", "ny"). Required unless q is provided.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1–50, default 20).

q.description: Full-text keyword search across bill titles and text (e.g. "climate change", "education funding").

session.description: Legislative session identifier to filter bills (e.g. "20252026" for 2025-2026 session). Format varies by state.

subject.description: Filter by subject/topic tag assigned to the bill (e.g. "Education", "Environment", "Health Care").

name: openstates.legislature.bills_search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search State Bills
